method.scope: runtime-only POC packages, not production Surffish application installers
method.description: Both runtime trees were staged independently from the existing builds, stripped of ELF debug sections, reduced to en-US.pak, and packaged with identical dpkg-deb xz level-6 settings. The same ten-list serialized Ghostery engine and Bramble probe were included in both packages. The packages were unpacked staging trees for this smoke benchmark; they were not installed. PSS was sampled every 500 ms in a memory-profile pass; CPU was measured in a separate pass with PSS disabled to avoid observer overhead.
method.compression: dpkg-deb xz level 6, uniform control/data compression
method.locale: en-US only; both POC launchers explicitly pass --lang=en-US
method.symbols: ELF .debug_* sections removed; dynamic and non-debug symbols retained
method.cgroupMemory: cgroup v2 memory.current came from the shared sandbox service cgroup, not an isolated benchmark cgroup, so it is diagnostic only and cannot be attributed to these process trees
method.pssPeak: PSS peaks are maxima among sampled smaps_rollup observations, not guaranteed instantaneous peaks
method.omitted: Production Surffish UI, full application dependencies, installers/integration, signing, update/uninstall paths, CEF secure sandbox configuration, and unsupported extension-host integration
